// The intersection of two 2D primitives
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intersection_(geometry)): a flag plus the
// discrete intersection points (empty when Intersects is false, or when the
// overlap is a region rather than isolated points).
type IntersectionResult2D
    implements IValue
{
    Intersects: Boolean;
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
}
